sloka: एवमुक्त्वा ततो राम भुजान्विक्षिप्य पर्वते ।तोलयामास तं शीघ्रं स शैलं समकम्पत ।। ७.१६.२५ ॥
transliteration: evamuktvā tato rāma bhujānvikṣipya parvate ।tolayāmāsa taṁ śīghraṁ sa śailaṁ samakampata ।। 7.16.25 ॥

translations.english: Having thus spoken, O Rama, (Ravana) spread his arms on the mountain and quickly began to lift it, causing that mountain to tremble.
